title: Lead Intelligence Platform
summary: A local event-tracking and analytics stack for e-commerce lead intelligence, built on Redpanda, ClickHouse, RudderStack, and Streamlit, that also produces synthetic session data for testing/training purposes. scripts/quick_train_ctgan.py builds SDV metadata and trains a CTGANSynthesizer, and generate_synthetic_sessions.py samples from it using SDV's conditional sampling (sdv.sampling.Condition).
evidence: scripts/quick_train_ctgan.py:102-108 uses SingleTableMetadata and CTGANSynthesizer; generate_synthetic_sessions.py:150 uses sdv.sampling.Condition
